content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DCCM Tenkasi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DCCM Tenkasi Technical Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technical Assistant: Undergraduate Degree from a recognized University, Basic Typewriting skills in both Tamil and English. At least 1 year of relevant work experience will be given first priority.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Technical Assistant: Maximum age must not exceed 40 years as of the date of application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications based on eligibility criteria by the DCCM Committee. In-person Interview and Typing Test (Tamil & English).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCCM Tenkasi Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://tenkasi.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Climate Change Mission Tenkasi (DCCM Tenkasi) in the state of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post being offered in this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The post available for recruitment is Technical Assistant under the District Climate Change Mission Tenkasi.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form along with required documents is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technical Assistant position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 22,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Undergraduate Degree from a recognized University along with basic typewriting skills in both Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as of the date of application submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via offline mode by downloading the form and sending it through post or in person.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official district website at https://tenkasi.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications by the DCCM Committee followed by an in-person interview and typing test.
